sections.title: Bringing Unit 19 together
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Unit 19: attending school or university with jár, marking a starting point with X óta, naming subjects and saying whether you're good or bad at them with -ban/-ben, speaking "in" a language with -ul/-ül, and expressing hopes with remélem, hogy... and a célom, hogy...

sections.title: School and language, recapped
rows: to practice, to repeat, to concentrate

items.english: I've been attending university in Budapest since September.

items.spanish: Jó vagyok matematikában, de rossz történelemben.
items.english: I'm good at mathematics, but bad at history.

items.spanish: A célom az, hogy jövőre folyékonyan beszéljek magyarul.
items.english: My goal is that next year I'll speak Hungarian fluently.

sections.content: Don't mix up magyarul beszélek ("I speak in Hungarian", the -ul/-ül way of naming a language) with tudok magyarul ("I know Hungarian") — both are correct, just built from different verbs.
